outcome: Undesirable or inappropriate procedures during childbirth
cohort: 4,087 women who delivered members of the 2015 Pelotas birth cohort in Pelotas City, Brazil
finding: Disrespect and abuse during childbirth was prevalent, with 18.3% of mothers reporting at least one type of mistreatment, and was associated with delivering in the public healthcare system and having a cesarean section after labor.
mod_finding: Women who had a cesarean section with previous labor had a higher risk of experiencing disrespect and abuse during childbirth.
